content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 Overview

rows.details: Development a Library of AI/ML ip cores

content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Research Fellow Important Dates
BITS Pilani Research Fellow Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: BITS Pilani has announced one Research Fellow vacancy under the DRDO-funded AI/ML IP cores project.

content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Research Fellow Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The Research Fellow position is applicable only to PhD aspirants . Candidates should also check and satisfy the eligibility criteria and qualification process prescribed for the BITS Pilani PhD programme. Candidates should have a Post Graduate or Graduate degree in any of the following disciplines, or an equivalent discipline, from a recognized university: Electronics Communication Instrumentation Computer Science EEE Equivalent discipline Strong background in digital design and hardware description language. Knowledge of FPGA-based system design will be an added advantage.

content_sections.heading: Scope of Work
content_sections.text: The project aims to develop a library of AI/ML algorithm IP cores in hardware.

content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Research Fellow Fellowship
content_sections.text: The fellowship ranges from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA . The amount will depend on the candidate's year of PhD and performance.

content_sections.heading: Duration
content_sections.text: The duration of the Research Fellow position will be as per BITS Pilani norms.

content_sections.heading: Place of Work
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will work at BITS Pilani, Goa Campus, Goa .

content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Research Fellow Selection Process
content_sections.text: Preliminary shortlisting will be based on the candidate's resume and a telephonic/audio-visual interview within a week of the last date of application. Candidates shortlisted for the final interview will be informed through email. No TA/DA will be provided in case of a personal interview. Resume-based preliminary shortlisting Telephonic/audio-visual interview Final interview for shortlisted candidates

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates have to submit the following with their application: CV Cover letter showing alignment and justification with the roles, responsibilities and requirements

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BITS Pilani Research Fellow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their application through the Google Form mentioned in the official notification by 25 September 2026 . Check the eligibility requirements for the Research Fellow position and BITS Pilani PhD programme. Prepare your CV. Prepare a cover letter explaining how your profile matches the project's roles and requirements. Open the prescribed online application form. Complete the application with the required information. Submit the application by 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in BITS Pilani Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BITS Pilani has announced one Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The position is only for PhD aspirants who meet the prescribed educational qualification and BITS Pilani PhD eligibility requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for BITS Pilani Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Graduate or Post Graduate degree in Electronics, Communication, Instrumentation, Computer Science, EEE or an equivalent discipline from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA, depending on the year of PhD and performance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Preliminary shortlisting will be based on the resume and a telephonic/audio-visual interview. Shortlisted candidates will subsequently be informed by email about the final interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the place of work?
faq.answer: The place of work is BITS Pilani, Goa Campus, Goa.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply using the prescribed Google Form and submit a CV and cover letter by 25 September 2026.
